name: io.github.polyrank/polyrank-mcp
title: Polyrank
description: Polymarket trader analytics for AI agents: rank wallets, read trader metrics, backtest strategies.

environmentVariables.name: POLYRANK_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the Polyrank API host (default https://api.polyrank.app).

environmentVariables.name: POLYRANK_AGENT_BASE
environmentVariables.description: Override the agent host whose free manifests (metric catalog, metric windows, Builder goals) are read (default https://api-agent.polyrank.app).

environmentVariables.name: POLYRANK_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Optional Polyrank API key (pk_live_…). Enables the authenticated tools: polyrank_rank_wallets (the Ranking Builder), polyrank_get_trader_metrics, the AI Lab tools and tid resolve. Anonymous tools work without it.

headers.name: Authorization
headers.description: Optional. Your Polyrank API key as a bearer token (pk_live_…, from https://polyrank.app/api-keys). Without it the 17 free read-only tools work; the Ranking Builder, per-window trader metrics and the AI Lab tools need it (they also need a paid plan with the AI Lab; results are simulated).
